name: Public review reply desk
why: Replies to each new batch of guest reviews and holds the risky ones for the host, the same rule as the review steps in the reviews and guest issues skill.

name: Review reply batch writer
why: A one-off version of the review reply prompt for a backlog of reviews, with risky ones flagged.

name: Complaint reply promise checker
why: Checks a reply to an unhappy guest for refunds or promises the host has not approved.

name: Refund request reply writer
why: Writes a clear yes, partial or no reply to a refund request once the host has chosen an option.

name: Hotel channel revenue reconciler
why: Reconciles nights and revenue by booking channel after commission, the channel step of the booking review skill for small hotels.

name: Prepare a hotel group booking handover
why: Hands over a confirmed group booking with deposits, requests and key dates for staff.

name: Explain service booking terms to customers
why: Turns the cancellation policy and house rules into plain words for the listing and messages.

name: Discount and price change checker
why: Checks the deepest discount the margin allows, matching the floor check on stacked discounts.

name: Price test keeper
why: Plans one undoable price test and reads the result, like the test-and-review step for nightly rates.

name: FAQ page writer from customer questions
why: Turns real guest questions into an FAQ for a direct booking site, alongside the house guide.

name: Self-assessment tax return checklist
why: Lists the records a UK host gathers and the questions for their accountant now holiday lets are taxed under normal landlord rules.
